invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of execute(), which is expected to be non-null.
records is received as a parameter and would be required for the execution of the commit action.
context is cast and used as a non-null argument in the commit action executor.
instantTime is used in the commit executor and is likely required to be non-null for correct execution.
The HoodieWriteMetadata object should contain a valid list of WriteStatus objects as part of the bulk insert contract.
